criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: S2, S8 and S5 strong. S4 back bar shows through the front ghost so 27 reads near 70 and the bottom 40 percent is a blue wash. S7 blade a flat slab, no hand, headline on a flat wall. S6 top 42 percent a flat navy plate, hub a flat plane. S1 stand untextured square tube, cases toy blocks. Only S2 holds as a magazine opener.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One palette and type system, gold as what the software touched, engine as a camera move on S1, S7, S9. S2 and S4 to S7 one ultramarine field; S8 Lubbock boss red-orange not gold.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; testing caveat on every slide; rejected list honest. S7 kicker 'People decide' goes past c15; S4 relief visually misstates the 27 bar.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what and where named on S1 and S8. Stake general; S9 watch line gives nothing to act on, honestly so.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: S1 to S2 pays at once, S9 lands the caveat. S3 to S5 three figure frames at one weight; S8 backstory slows the close.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Caption hook is a real turn; body copy leans on the release; little regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject; mix of studio objects and reliefs; another v2 blue-sweep explainer with stock grid and bar devices.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild S4 so it reads true at feed size and put a gloved hand and borescope on a modelled airfoil in S7.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Front ghost shows the back bar through it so 27 reads near 70; top ghost reads full length; bottom 40 percent empty.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Frost both ghosts translucent white, pull the bars apart in depth so neither occludes, drop the camera low and close.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Nothing inspects; blade a flat slab; type on a flat wall plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Twisted airfoil in a foam cutout with a gloved hand holding the borescope at the gold band, camera in, lit door panels behind the type.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Top 42 percent a flat navy plate, hub a flat plane with drawn lines.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise and rotate the camera so leading edges climb behind the body copy, crop the hub out.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stand untextured square tube, cases matte blocks on a plain sweep.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera to knee height and closer, chamfered tube stand with gussets, moulded ribbed cases with recessed latches.
